name: Faith
summary: Trusting God and responding to his word with perseverance and action.

name: Prayer
summary: Bringing requests, gratitude and distress to God while learning to listen and persevere.

name: Worship
summary: Recognizing who God is and directing our lives toward serving him.

name: Fasting
summary: Seeking God through abstaining from food, without display and alongside justice.

name: Obedience
summary: Listening to God's word and putting it into practice.

name: Gratitude
summary: Recognizing God's gifts and cultivating thanksgiving.

name: Trust in God
summary: Entrusting our path to God and seeking direction amid uncertainty.

name: Seeking God
summary: Turning toward God sincerely and with a willingness to listen.

name: God's word
summary: Receiving, reflecting on and practicing Scripture as guidance for life.

name: God's guidance
summary: Seeking wisdom for decisions and recognizing the limits of our plans.

name: Anxiety
summary: Bringing worries to God and learning to live one day at a time.

name: Fear
summary: Finding courage and support in God amid danger and insecurity.

name: Suffering
summary: Making room for lament and hope without reducing pain to easy explanations.

name: Grief
summary: Expressing the pain of loss and receiving comfort and hope.

name: Hope
summary: Waiting with perseverance for God's care and promises.

name: Peace
summary: Seeking reconciliation and receiving the peace Jesus announces.

name: Joy
summary: Celebrating God's goodness and finding reasons for joy amid difficulties.

name: Loneliness
summary: Expressing abandonment and finding care in God and community.

name: Anger
summary: Recognizing anger and responding without feeding violence or resentment.

name: Weariness
summary: Recognizing our limits and receiving rest and renewal.

name: Love
summary: Loving God and our neighbors through care, commitment and service.

name: Forgiveness
summary: Receiving God's forgiveness and responding to wrongs without revenge.

name: Friendship
summary: Cultivating loyalty, presence and mutual care.

name: Marriage
summary: Exploring marital commitment, faithfulness and mutual care.

name: Family
summary: Learning about care, responsibilities and passing on faith across generations.

name: Children
summary: Recognizing children's dignity and the responsibility to welcome them.

name: Reconciliation
summary: Seeking to restore relationships with truth, responsibility and peace.

name: Hospitality
summary: Welcoming people and sharing life and available resources.

name: Love for enemies
summary: Responding to hostility without revenge and seeking our opponents' good.

name: Words and communication
summary: Speaking truthfully and carefully, with a willingness to listen.

name: Wisdom
summary: Discerning how to live, decide and act before God.

name: Humility
summary: Recognizing our limits and considering the good of others.

name: Patience
summary: Learning to wait and treat others with perseverance and gentleness.

name: Integrity
summary: Keeping words and actions consistent, even when it costs something.

name: Self-control
summary: Directing desires and reactions toward responsibility and love.

name: Courage
summary: Acting faithfully in situations of fear, opposition or risk.

name: Gentleness
summary: Treating people firmly and carefully, without arrogance or aggression.

name: Faithfulness
summary: Persevering in commitment to God and entrusted responsibilities.

name: Temptation
summary: Recognizing temptation and seeking help to resist evil.

name: Envy
summary: Examining comparison and resentment while cultivating contentment and love.

name: Work
summary: Working responsibly and considering the dignity and limits of work.

name: Money
summary: Examining our relationship with possessions, financial security and neighbors.

name: Generosity
summary: Sharing resources willingly, responsibly and attentively to others' needs.

name: Justice
summary: Acting fairly and defending people exposed to oppression and exploitation.

name: Rest
summary: Making time to rest, worship and recognize that life is more than production.

name: Contentment
summary: Learning to live without making material abundance the measure of life.

name: Poverty and care
summary: Recognizing material needs and acting with compassion and justice.

name: Stewardship
summary: Caring for the possessions, abilities and responsibilities entrusted to us.

name: Plans and decisions
summary: Planning with prudence, humility and attention to consequences.

name: Care for creation
summary: Recognizing creation as God's work and reflecting on human responsibility.

name: Grace
summary: Receiving God's favor as a gift that transforms how we live.

name: Salvation
summary: Exploring how Scripture presents God's action to save and restore.

name: Repentance
summary: Recognizing sin and turning toward God with a change of direction.

name: Sin
summary: Examining our broken relationship with God and neighbors and the need for forgiveness.

name: Covenant
summary: Following God's commitments and promises throughout the biblical narrative.

name: Kingdom of God
summary: Exploring Jesus' announcement of God's reign and its implications.

name: Holy Spirit
summary: Reading passages about the Spirit's presence, work and gifts.

name: Creation
summary: Contemplating God as creator and humanity's place in his work.

name: Redemption
summary: Following the language of liberation and rescue in God's work.

name: Holiness
summary: Exploring the call to belong to God and live consistently with that relationship.

name: Service
summary: Putting abilities and resources at the service of our neighbors.

name: Unity
summary: Cultivating fellowship while recognizing diverse gifts and responsibilities.

name: Fellowship
summary: Sharing faith, life and mutual care in community.

name: Mission
summary: Participating in proclaiming the gospel and bearing witness to Jesus.

name: Spiritual gifts
summary: Understanding gifts as ways to serve and build up the community.

name: Leadership
summary: Taking responsibility for others through example, service and care.

name: Church
summary: Exploring biblical images of the community gathered around Christ.

name: Baptism
summary: Reading accounts and teachings about baptism in their contexts.

name: Lord's Supper
summary: Remembering Jesus' self-giving and reflecting on fellowship and responsibility at the table.

name: Mutual care
summary: Supporting one another through presence, encouragement and practical help.

name: Resurrection
summary: Exploring testimony about Jesus' resurrection and the hope it grounds.

name: Eternal life
summary: Reading Jesus' teaching about life received from God.

name: Death
summary: Facing human mortality and God's promises in the face of death.

name: Judgment
summary: Reflecting on responsibility, justice and accountability before God.

name: Return of Christ
summary: Exploring promises of Jesus' return and the call to watchfulness.

name: New creation
summary: Discovering biblical images of renewal, restoration and God's presence.

name: Watchfulness
summary: Living attentively and faithfully while awaiting God's promises.

name: Perseverance
summary: Continuing in faith through difficulty, sustained by hope.

name: Inheritance in Christ
summary: Exploring the language of inheritance and belonging in God's promises.

name: God with us
summary: Following the promise of God's presence with his people.
